            2. _Ziad Hb_, Aug 19, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible lag on my S26 Ultra making the app non usable Does not diffrentiate finger from pen, I need to quit the pen tool in order to pan or else my fingers will write same like the pen"

Paid microsoft subscription and expect privacy to be respected and apps to work, not become unusable and lose ease of use and personal data when the app updates itself. Similar issues with other microsoft apps. If paid they should work with ease mobile only without computer and data should be private."
